mapper.select: SELECT id, slug, name, sort_order FROM fl_category ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.sql: w.id, w.work_type AS type, w.slug, w.title, w.summary, w.release_date, c.id AS category_id, c.slug AS category_slug, c.name AS category_name, c.sort_order AS category_sort_order, cover.id AS cover_id, cover.resource_url AS cover_url, cover.alt_text AS cover_alt_text, a.episode_count, a.studio, a.airing_status, g.developer, g.age_rating
FROM fl_work w JOIN fl_category c ON c.id = w.category_id LEFT JOIN fl_anime a ON a.work_id = w.id LEFT JOIN fl_game g ON g.work_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN fl_work_image cover ON cover.work_id = w.id AND cover.image_kind = 'COVER' AND cover.sort_order = 0
w.is_listed = 1 AND (a.work_id IS NOT NULL OR g.work_id IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY w.release_date DESC NULLS LAST, w.id DESC OFFSET #{query.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{query.size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.name FROM fl_tag t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fl_work_tag wt JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = wt.work_id WHERE wt.tag_id = t.id AND w.work_type = #{type} AND w.is_listed = 1 ) ORDER BY t.slug
SELECT wt.work_id, t.id, t.slug, t.name FROM fl_work_tag wt JOIN fl_tag t ON t.id = wt.tag_id WHERE wt.work_id IN #{workId} ORDER BY wt.work_id, t.slug
SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.name FROM fl_work_tag wt JOIN fl_tag t ON t.id = wt.tag_id WHERE wt.work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY t.slug
SELECT id, image_kind AS kind, resource_url AS url, alt_text, sort_order FROM fl_work_image WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY image_kind, sort_order, id
